payload.title: Port rangercrm-server to Rust (dogfood app)
payload.description: Rewrite apps/rangercrm-server (~200 lines) as the first real consumer of the Rust library-embed API: Rust schema DSL, server wiring, grants usage. Serves as the living example for docs/authoring.md and validates the developer experience end-to-end with the RangerCRM iOS client.
